links.outcome: Whether manual review of sampled outputs corrects the automated LLM-as-judge error flags
links.effect: Manual review of a subset found that most claims the automated judge flagged as errors were supported by the patient chart, so human validation was needed to estimate real error rates.
links.quote: Subsequent manual review of a subset of outputs revealed that most claims flagged by the automated judge as errors were in fact supported by the patient chart, demonstrating the importance of human validation.

unlisted_practices: LLM-as-judge automated evaluation of deployed LLM outputs
Citation-linked claims in LLM responses to support verification
Randomized crossover trial measuring time savings and NASA-TLX workload for an LLM EHR search tool

screen.reason: Evaluates an LLM-based EHR search tool via a randomized crossover trial and real pilot deployment, measuring clinician workload, time, and accuracy.
